observations: Viewed both original cloud PNGs from the EL7 and Ubuntu 24.04 desktop runs. All 20 DPM rows, the view selector and the bottom limitation text fit and are readable.

The sample shares are 25/0/50/25 percent. State 1 clock and voltage policies remain visible despite its zero share. Four voltage policies are 1/1.125/1.25/1.375 V; state-0 clock policies are 2000/1800/3600 nominal MHz.

Statuses explicitly distinguish clock policy from measured frequency, voltage policy from device readback and sample share from time residency. The footer identifies nominal 100 MHz arithmetic, candidate physical clock identities, unresolved physical rails and unverified capture provenance.
Raw words and offsets are visible for every row. The capture metadata shows table 0x00620205 with 2452 captured/expected bytes. State numbers are not labeled as CCDs or OS CPUs.
These are offline synthetic snapshots. The disabled native-reader control retains its default Shimada selection; it does not identify the loaded snapshot or demonstrate a native hardware read.
